mutants.description: spi_enable, the host's CONTROL run-enable for the converter, is mistaken for an SPI-interface enable and gates the slave's chip select, so a host that disables the converter is locked off the bus
mutants.reason: After the host writes CONTROL to clear spi_enable, every later SPI transaction is ignored: writes are not applied and MISO stays low on reads. This lasts until a switch press re-asserts spi_enable. In the correct design the bus keeps working while the converter is host-disabled.

mutants.description: spi_slave is handed the inverted filtered chip select, as if CS were active high, so the idle bus looks selected and a real transaction looks deselected
mutants.reason: While the master holds CS_n low for a transaction, the slave sees itself deselected, so it shifts in no command, applies no write and never drives read data on MISO. Its framing instead runs while CS_n idles high.

mutants.description: pwm_mask's PWM input is gated by the gate-driver enable En, adding the second logic shutdown path that the header explicitly rules out
mutants.reason: In S_OFF and S_HICCUP, or whenever a fault pulls En low, PWM_out stays low instead of carrying the masked modulator pulses. A fault that drops En mid-pulse also cuts the PWM_out pulse short on that same clock.

mutants.description: hiccup_timer is given strike_level minus one, as if the strike count had not already been incremented on entry to S_HICCUP, so each cool-down is half its intended length
mutants.reason: The first hiccup re-enables En after one base interval (5 ms by default) instead of two (10 ms), and the second after 10 ms instead of 20 ms. The time S_HICCUP holds the gate driver off before each retry is halved.

mutants.description: pgood_gen's qualifying delay is converted with ms_to_clks, as for the debouncers, although pgood_gen counts switching cycles, so the 9 ms qualification becomes 450000 PWM cycles (about 1 s)
mutants.reason: After the supervisor enters S_RUN with the output comparator good, PGOOD and switch_supply assert about 1 s later instead of about 9 ms later. pgood_LED is delayed by the same amount.
